description: Custom structure and hardware CAD: plates generated from a module's UHD bolt patterns and frames, and nominal fastener bodies from their sizes, both as a provider of the cad capability (build123d), with STEP/GLB/DXF exports, feature manifests, frame and staleness checks and explicit re-binding.

skills.summary: Generate a custom structure's CAD from its UHD interfaces, keep geometry bindings honest, re-bind after changes, and export for manufacturing (DXF/STEP for CNC carbon)
Verify a generated structure before cutting: bindings, reproducibility, placement, DXF manufacturability (edge distance, webs, bit limits)

tools.purpose: Python with build123d (CAD kernel for the plate generator)
tools.install: protoboard tools install cad (a project venv with these pins), or point PROTOBOARD_PYTHON at an interpreter with build123d==0.13.0

capabilities.summary: Plates (frames, top plates, brackets) from a module's UHD bolt patterns and frames, and nominal mounting-hardware bodies (screws, nuts, standoffs, spacers) from their sizes, with build123d; DXF cutting profiles for plates

generate.summary: Write the generator parameters from the module's interfaces and constraints (frame-cad/params.json), run the generator and keep the frames it measured (frame-cad/frames.json); returns the signatures and any bindings that changed

export.summary: Rebuild the body from frame-cad/params.json and write out/body.step, body.glb, body.manifest.json, body.dxf and out/interfaces/<id>.glb

extract.summary: The generated interface frames and the module's artifacts (re-bind them with frame-cad-rebind)

check.summary: Interface frames match the generated frames; the design is not stale against the interfaces and constraints; out/ was exported from the current design

margin_mm.description: outline margin around core holes and clamps (default 3)

arm_slot_width_mm.description: lightening slot down each arm; 0 = none (default 5)

hub_extra_mm.description: hub disc radius beyond the pad (default 1)

pad_height_mm.description: raised pad height above the plate top (default 0.5)

clamp_height_mm.description: side-clamp frame origin height above the plate top (default: from the frame)

pads.description: interface ids that are raised pads (default: circle patterns facing up)

outline_mm.description: explicit plate outline { x: [min, max], y: [min, max] } (default: hull of the patterns)

slots_mm.description: rectangular cut-outs [{ center: [x, y], size: [w, h] }]

operations.summary: Alias of cad:generate then cad:export for every plate module (or the named ones), each bound by its cad.config.ts; returns the new signatures and any stale bindings

module.description: comma-separated module ids (default: every local plate module, i.e. mechanical metadata plate_thickness_mm)

operations.summary: Copy the exported signatures (out/body.manifest.json) and generated frame origins (frame-cad/frames.json) into the module source (explicit re-binding after a reviewed change); prints every change

module.description: comma-separated module ids (default: every plate module with generated CAD)

operations.summary: Alias of cad:generate then cad:export for every mounting-hardware module (screws, nuts, standoffs, spacers; or the named ones), each bound by its cad.config.ts: nominal STEP, GLB and manifest with volume from its UHD sizes; returns each volume and the one it replaces

module.description: comma-separated module ids (default: every local hardware module used, i.e. tagged fastener and screw, nut, standoff or spacer)

operations.summary: Manufacturing Package: the cut order of each plate in its unit's work order (process, material, stock, quantities by DXF layer, hole sizes, router bit, edge finish)
Manufacturing Package: inspection of what the cut order asks for (hole sizes, edges, edge distance)

checks.summary: Plate modules that no cad.config.ts binds to this provider (each bound module's frames and staleness are its cad:check)
Mounting-hardware modules that no cad.config.ts binds to this provider (each bound module's stale sizes and export are its cad:check)
